description: Defines a singleton repository class 'ShopRepository' that provides mock data for categories, products, cart management, favorites, recent searches, catalog preferences, and paging for a shopping app. It includes methods for managing cart items, favorites, searches, and querying product catalog pages with filtering, sorting, and in-memory paging.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CatalogPreferences
classes.description: Stores catalog filter and sort preferences such as selected category, sort key, and favorites-only filter.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CatalogQuery
classes.description: Defines parameters for catalog queries including category, search terms, sort order, and favorites filter.

classes.name: ShopRepository.PagedProducts
classes.description: Represents a page of catalog products, indicating if the end of data is reached.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
classes.description: Models a cart item with associated product and quantity, includes methods to compute total line cost.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves list of catalog categories.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Retrieves list of all products.

methods.name: findProductById
methods.description: Finds a product by its ID.

methods.name: getCategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of a category given its ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository, restoring persisted state (cart, searches, favorites). Should be called once early in app lifecycle.

methods.name: cartLiveData
methods.description: Returns LiveData observing cart state.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for a product in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: cartItems
methods.description: Returns a list of CartItem objects representing current cart contents.

methods.name: cartTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates total cost of items in the cart in cents.

methods.name: getRecentSearches
methods.description: Returns recent search queries.

methods.name: recordSearchQuery
methods.description: Records a search query, maintaining a capped recent searches list and persisting.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears recent searches.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a product is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles favorite status of a product and persists changes.

methods.name: getFavorites
methods.description: Retrieves set of favorite product IDs.

methods.name: observeFavorites
methods.description: Returns LiveData for observing favorite IDs.

methods.name: loadCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Loads catalog filter and sort preferences, defaulting if none stored.

methods.name: saveCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Persists catalog filter and sort preferences.

methods.name: getCatalogFirstPage
methods.description: Fetches first page of catalog based on query, applies filtering, sorting, and simulates delay.

methods.name: getCatalogNextPage
methods.description: Fetches subsequent pages of catalog, treating query changes as resets.

methods.name: producePage
methods.description: Produces a page of products based on current filtered/sorted list.

methods.name: buildCatalogFilteredSorted
methods.description: Filters and sorts products based on query parameters and favorites.

methods.name: relevanceScore
methods.description: Calculates relevance score for a product based on search query match.

methods.name: publishCart
methods.description: Updates LiveData for cart and persists state.

methods.name: publishFavorites
methods.description: Updates LiveData for favorites and persists.
